system.description:
• Effect: As your action, take the form of a natural beast (a creature whose type line reads beast) from Monsters & Treasure, of Level no greater than two-thirds of your Druid level, rounded down (minimum Level 1, maximum Level 10), once per day (more often as you rise in level, below).
  • Choose the form fresh each time; never a swarm, a spellcaster or a creature marked Solo (see Druid Forms).
  • Until 5th level a form with a flying speed must be Small or smaller.
  • Lasts up to 1 hour or until you revert, which takes no action.
  • You take the form's stat block from Monsters & Treasure: its HP, AC, attacks, Fortitude and Reflex saves and movement; the form's HP cannot exceed your own Max HP.
  • A form's AC is its own: Barkskin and armour do not add to it.
  • You keep your own mind and personality, your Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma, your Will save and your spell DC. Your gear melds into the form and does nothing until you revert.
  • In Wild Shape you can't cast spells or use an action a spell gives you (calling a bolt, hurling a flame). Spells already in effect continue, and a spell you are concentrating on continues.
  • When the form drops to 0 HP you return to your own form with the HP you had when you changed (see Changing Shape in Spellcasting in Arneyan).
  • 3rd level: usable twice per day
  • 6th level: usable three times per day
  • 9th level: usable four times per day
  • 15th level: usable five times per day

activities.name: Wild Shape
activities.text: Shapeshift into a beast or beast-like monster of Level up to two-thirds of your Druid level (rounded down, at least 1) for up to 1 hour, taking its whole stat block.
